name: Zero Point Module
plugin params: mining, refining, farming, lightindustry, population, fuelprod, heavyindustry, orbitalworks, stargate_complex
desc: Unlock the ultimate power source with the Zero Point Module (ZPM), a compact energy generator capable of harnessing the vacuum energy from a zero-point field. Engineered with advanced alien technology, the ZPM offers nearly unlimited power, making it an essential component for high-energy demands, such as powering starships, defensive shields, beam weapons or industries. The ZPM is self-sustaining, with no moving parts, and can operate for thousands of years without maintenance. However, it requires precise integration and handling, as its power output is immense. Ideal for any advanced civilization looking to maintain peak operational efficiency.
